war_summary: On Day 113 of War 139, intense frontline clashes and rapid base turnover persist across pivotal central and coastal battlegrounds. Endless Shore, Oarbreaker, and Godcrofts continue to experience relentless back-and-forth engagements and heavy base turnover. Meanwhile, massive casualty surges and fresh strategic pressure are escalating rapidly in Clahstra, Marban Hollow, and Speaking Woods, making these hexes the primary flashpoints for impending territory changes.
